'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Good day, mercenary. I've got another job for you. One of my regular clients is looking for an AKM fitted with a Fortis Shift foregrip, a suppressor, and a 30-round Magpul magazine. It also needs ergonomics at or above 25, combined recoil below 400, and a sighting range of at least 800. Think you can handle it? There's no rush, but I'd rather not keep the client waiting too long.}}

==Requirements==
* This quest is only obtainable by [[BEAR]] PMCs.

==Objectives==
* Modify an [[AKM]] to comply with the given specifications

==Rewards==
* +28,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Mechanic]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.75'''</font>
* 275,000 Roubles
** 288,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 316,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
{{quote|Comfortable to handle, and expertly put together. Thank you. I'll let the client know their weapon is ready for pickup.}}

==Guide==
[[AKM]] specifications:
* 60 Durability
* 400 or less recoil
* 25 or more ergonomics
* 800 or greater sighting range
* A silencer
* [[Fortis Shift tactical foregrip]]
* [[AK 7.62x39 Magpul PMAG 30 GEN M3 30-round magazine]] (Black)

==Build==
'''This is one example of many possible configurations.'''
====<font color="red">Notes:</font>====
* This build is based on a standard [[AKM]] from [[Prapor]] LL2.
* The [[Fortis Shift tactical foregrip]] can also be obtained through the [[MPX]] (MQB variant) barter at [[Mechanic]] LL1.
* The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
